secrets.name: AGENT_PROVIDER
secrets.description: Primary model provider: replay (default, zero-key), anthropic, featherless, or nebius

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com (when AGENT_PROVIDER=anthropic)

secrets.name: FEATHERLESS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Featherless API key from featherless.ai (when AGENT_PROVIDER=featherless)

secrets.name: NEBIUS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Nebius Token Factory API key from studio.nebius.com (when AGENT_PROVIDER=nebius or fallback)

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
secrets.description: ElevenLabs API key from elevenlabs.io for multi-voice crew speech synthesis

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL from Supabase Dashboard -> Settings -> API for cross-run persistence

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role secret key from Supabase Dashboard -> Settings -> API

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Composio MCP consumer key (x-consumer-api-key) for live Google Calendar integration

secrets.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tavily API key from app.tavily.com for live researcher web search

secrets.name: QLOO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Qloo API key for destination taste recommendations

secrets.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firecrawl API key from firecrawl.dev for secondary science paper retrieval
